name: agentforge-root
description: AgentForge — build and deploy AI agents without code

scripts.electron:dev: concurrently "cd frontend && npm run dev" "sleep 5 && cd electron && ELECTRON_IS_DEV=1 node_modules/.bin/electron ."
scripts.electron:build: cd frontend && BUILD_TARGET=electron npm run build && cd ../electron && npm install && npm run build
scripts.electron:build:mac: cd frontend && BUILD_TARGET=electron npm run build && cd ../electron && npm install && npm run build:mac
scripts.electron:build:win: cd frontend && BUILD_TARGET=electron npm run build && cd ../electron && npm install && npm run build:win
scripts.electron:build:linux: cd frontend && BUILD_TARGET=electron npm run build && cd ../electron && npm install && npm run build:linux
